nonClaims: full FFV1 conformance solely from a zero-failure MediaConch report when its clean-file FFV1 checker executes zero tests
visual or artistic correctness of the frame content
colorimetric accuracy beyond the bounded pixel/chroma fields checked by R1

formatPolicy.canonicalDecodedVideo: rawvideo yuv422p frames in presentation/decode order
formatPolicy.integrityPolicy: MediaConch built-in implementation checks must report zero failures and zero warnings; Matroska/EBML checks must execute. FFV1 checker zero tests on a clean file is not promoted to full FFV1 conformance evidence, but any reported FFV1 implementation failure is release-blocking.

contractSchema.claim: moving-image object contract is valid under moving-image-ffv1-contract-v1

decodedVideoIdentity.claim: FFmpeg decodes the exact artifact to the canonical rawvideo representation with contract-derived byte count and optional SHA-256 identity

ffprobeTechnical.claim: FFprobe independently identifies one FFV1 video stream and agrees on dimensions, frame rate, frame count, pixel format, bit depth and progressive scan

ffv1Implementation.claim: MediaConch reports no FFV1 implementation failures/warnings; absence of positive FFV1 tests is explicitly not interpreted as full codec conformance

matroskaImplementation.claim: MediaConch executes Matroska/EBML implementation checks and reports zero failures/warnings on the exact artifact

mediaInfoTechnical.claim: MediaInfo identifies Matroska v4, stable FFV1 v3 micro-version >=4, and technical video facts matching the object contract

streamTopology.claim: artifact contains exactly one video stream and no audio/subtitle streams in bounded R1
